semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-purity transport containers and bubblers for electronic chemicals used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Dipl.-Ing. Wilhelm Schmidt GmbH is a leading manufacturer of stainless steel ampoules, bottles, and cylinders designed for high-purity electronic chemicals. Their products ensure particle-free performance and are utilized for safe and efficient supply logistics in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Manufacturing of stainless steel transport containers for ultrapure media
Production of MOCVD bubblers for precursors and dopants
Design of high-purity containers for microelectronics
Development of UN transport containers for hazardous materials

regional_presence.Germany: The company manufactures all products in Germany, emphasizing local production and quality.
